installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

apt-get update
apt-get install -y curl jq file tar unzip zip ca-certificates

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

# Limpiar binarios anteriores para reinstalaciones limpias, preservando mundos y configs
rm -rf bin PocketMine-MP.phar

ARCH=$([[ "$(uname -m)" == "x86_64" ]] && printf "amd64" || printf "arm64")
VERSION="${VERSION:-PM5}"
VERSION="${VERSION^^}"

if [[ "${VERSION}" == "PM4" ]]; then
  REQUIRED_PHP_VERSION="8.1"
  PHP_VARIANT="PM4"
  PHP_URL="https://github.com/QXRND/PHP-Binaries/releases/download/php-8.1-latest/php81pm4.tar.gz"
  DOWNLOAD_REPO="QXRND/PocketMine-MP-PM4"
  DOWNLOAD_ASSET="PocketMine-MP.phar"
  FALLBACK_PHAR="https://github.com/QXRND/PocketMine-MP-PM4/releases/download/v4.26.0-qxrnd.3/PocketMine-MP.phar"
elif [[ "${VERSION}" == "PM5" ]]; then
  REQUIRED_PHP_VERSION="8.2"
  PHP_VARIANT="PM5"
  PHP_URL="https://github.com/QXRND/PHP-Binaries/releases/download/php-8.2-latest/php82pm5.tar.gz"
  DOWNLOAD_REPO="QXRND/PocketMine-MP-PM5"
  DOWNLOAD_ASSET="PocketMine-MP.phar"
  FALLBACK_PHAR="https://github.com/QXRND/PocketMine-MP-PM5/releases/download/v5.44.5-qxrnd.20/PocketMine-MP.phar"
elif [[ "${VERSION}" == "PM6" ]]; then
  REQUIRED_PHP_VERSION="8.3"
  PHP_VARIANT="PM6"
  PHP_URL="https://github.com/pmmp/PHP-Binaries/releases/download/pm5-php-8.3-latest/PHP-8.3-Linux-x86_64-PM5.tar.gz"
  DOWNLOAD_REPO="QXRND/PocketMine-MP-PM6"
  DOWNLOAD_ASSET="PocketMine-MP.phar"
  FALLBACK_PHAR="https://github.com/QXRND/PocketMine-MP-PM6/releases/download/qxrnd-26.44/PocketMine-MP.phar"
else
  echo "Unsupported version: ${VERSION}. Use PM4, PM5 or PM6."
  exit 1
fi

if [[ "${ARCH}" != "amd64" ]]; then
  echo "This egg currently supports x86_64/amd64 PHP binaries only."
  exit 1
fi

echo "=========================================================="
echo " Instalando PocketMine-MP ${VERSION} (QXRND)               "
echo " Mantenedor: DevPapo | Licencias: licences.scon.host      "
echo "=========================================================="

# 1. Descarga del runtime de PHP
echo "Descargando entorno PHP ${REQUIRED_PHP_VERSION} para ${VERSION}..."
PHP_OK=false
if curl -sSL --fail --location --retry 3 --connect-timeout 10 "${PHP_URL}" | tar -xzv; then
  PHP_OK=true
else
  echo "Fallo descarga de PHP_URL principal, intentando mirror oficial de PMMP..."
  FALLBACK_PHP="https://github.com/pmmp/PHP-Binaries/releases/download/pm5-php-${REQUIRED_PHP_VERSION}-latest/PHP-${REQUIRED_PHP_VERSION}-Linux-x86_64-PM5.tar.gz"
  if curl -sSL --fail --location --retry 3 --connect-timeout 10 "${FALLBACK_PHP}" | tar -xzv; then
    PHP_OK=true
  fi
fi

if [ "$PHP_OK" = "false" ] || [ ! -f "bin/php7/bin/php" ]; then
  echo "Error fatal: No se pudo instalar el binario de PHP."
  exit 1
fi

chmod -R +x bin/

# Ajuste de php.ini para evitar errores de opcache o extension_dir
if [[ -f bin/php7/bin/php.ini ]]; then
  sed -i -E 's|^[[:space:]]*zend_extension[[:space:]]*=.*opcache\.so.*$|; zend_extension=opcache.so|' bin/php7/bin/php.ini
  EXT_DIR=$(find /mnt/server/bin/ -type d -name '*debug-zts*' 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
  if [ -n "$EXT_DIR" ]; then
    grep -q '^extension_dir' bin/php7/bin/php.ini && \
      sed -i "s{^extension_dir=.*{extension_dir=\"$EXT_DIR\"{" bin/php7/bin/php.ini || \
      echo "extension_dir=\"$EXT_DIR\"" >> bin/php7/bin/php.ini
  fi
fi

# 2. Descargar PocketMine-MP.phar desde Release
echo "Descargando PocketMine-MP.phar (${VERSION})...
"
PHAR_OK=false

DOWNLOAD_LINK=$(curl -sSL --connect-timeout 5 "https://api.github.com/repos/${DOWNLOAD_REPO}/releases/latest" 2>/dev/null | jq -r --arg asset "${DOWNLOAD_ASSET}" '.assets[]? | select(.name == $asset) | .browser_download_url' 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)

if [[ -n "${DOWNLOAD_LINK}" && "${DOWNLOAD_LINK}" != "null" ]]; then
  echo "Descargando desde latest release: ${DOWNLOAD_LINK}"
  if curl --fail --location --retry 3 --connect-timeout 15 "${DOWNLOAD_LINK}" --output PocketMine-MP.phar; then
    if [[ -s PocketMine-MP.phar && $(wc -c < PocketMine-MP.phar) -gt 1000000 ]]; then
      PHAR_OK=true
    fi
  fi
fi

if [[ "$PHAR_OK" = "false" ]]; then
  echo "Aviso: Usando fallback directo de release: ${FALLBACK_PHAR}"
  curl --fail --location --retry 3 --connect-timeout 15 "${FALLBACK_PHAR}" --output PocketMine-MP.phar || true
  if [[ -s PocketMine-MP.phar && $(wc -c < PocketMine-MP.phar) -gt 1000000 ]]; then
    PHAR_OK=true
  fi
fi

if [[ "$PHAR_OK" = "false" ]]; then
  echo "Error fatal: No se pudo descargar PocketMine-MP.phar."
  exit 1
fi

chmod +x PocketMine-MP.phar

# 3. Configurar licencia SCON Licensing (Integrada nativamente en el núcleo PM5)
echo "Configurando licencia SCON Licensing..."
mkdir -p scon-license
if [[ -n "${LICENSE_KEY}" && "${LICENSE_KEY}" != "null" ]]; then
  echo "Registrando clave de licencia en scon-license.yml..."
  cat << EOF_LICENSE > scon-license.yml
license-key: "${LICENSE_KEY}"
EOF_LICENSE
fi

# 4. Crear server.properties si no existe
if [[ ! -f server.properties ]]; then
  cat << 'EOF_PROPERTIES' > server.properties
motd=PocketMine-MP Bedrock Server
server-port=19132
server-ip=0.0.0.0
view-distance=16
white-list=off
max-players=20
gamemode=0
difficulty=1
pvp=on
enable-query=on
enable-rcon=off
auto-save=on
EOF_PROPERTIES
fi

touch banned-ips.txt banned-players.txt ops.txt white-list.txt server.log
mkdir -p players worlds plugins resource_packs
echo "${VERSION} instalacion completada exitosamente! Mantenedor: admin@scon.host"
